title: Evaluating Reinforcement Learning Safety and Trustworthiness in Cyber-Physical Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical framework (SAFE-RL) for evaluating the safety and trustworthiness of reinforcement learning in cyber-physical systems. While it addresses human-centric design and accountability, these are treated as systems engineering requirements and safety assurance goals rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
